hypothesis: An agency with an upcoming Shopify catalog job values a clear, value-redacted handoff pack at EUR 9 per catalog.
free_pilot: Voluntary request to use the current local checker and report, with optional feedback; no guaranteed place or paid order.
start_rule: Record actual collection activation time after both blockers are resolved. Do not backdate an experiment start to deployment or preparation.
qualifying_pilot: Voluntary separate consent, self-reported agency/merchant/catalog role, Shopify, real import within 30 days, pilot box checked; contact ownership and independent identity still require review.
genuine_visitor_rule: Consented, visible, trusted-interaction sessions with 10 seconds active time and declared relevant role are candidates only. No fingerprinting. Repeat sessions, bots that mimic people and unverified relevance prevent a claim of verified unique people.
completed_evaluation_rule: At most one per consented engaged relevant session, with local file, explicit real-catalog declaration and a generated report with at least one data record. Samples, failed reads, QA and unconsented activity are excluded.
independence_rule: Distinct email hashes are not independent verified buyers. Review permissioned contact responses and actual business context; exclude owner, staff, AI/test accounts and duplicate businesses before marking independently_verified.

decision_policy.continue_product_development: Only after documented, credible independent demand; targets are provisional and do not establish product-market fit.
decision_policy.improve: Qualified feedback shows interest but rejects price, proposition or missing handoff benefit; version the proposition before retest.
decision_policy.pivot: Sufficient confirmed relevant exposure plus weak evaluated demand; record channel quality and test another hypothesis.
decision_policy.insufficient_exposure: Distribution unresolved; do not declare demand disproven or manufacture traffic.

notifications: Only credible demand, authorization decisions, material issues or operational blockers. Routine zero-demand results stay in private records.
product_expansion_gate: Independent customer evidence before further feature development; no automatic acceptance from sessions or unverified signups.
monitor_backup_trigger: After successful trusted main-branch Daily research pilot completion; API-verified provenance and same daily cap.
